senses.why: Liberty of the body grows into liberty of choice.

senses.title: Release from something bad

senses.definitionCN: 不再遭受某种有害事物的状态
senses.example: The new law gives people freedom from unfair fees.

intro.en: Freedom joins the old word free with the suffix -dom.
intro.cn: freedom 由古词 free 与后缀 -dom 组合而成。

items.en: The suffix -dom meant a state or condition.
items.cn: 后缀 -dom 表示状态或境况。

items.en: Freedom meant the state of a free person.
items.cn: freedom 指自由人的身份状态。

items.en: It grew to mean rights of speech and choice.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示言论和选择的权利。

items.en: It also means release from harm.

note.en: Freedom is compared with words that look similar and words for liberty.
note.cn: 把 freedom 与形近词以及表示自由的词作比较。

the act of letting someone go

abstract.en: A free hand writes better than a chained one.
abstract.cn: 自由的手比被锁住的手写得更好。

abstract.en: Freedom grows where choices are respected.
abstract.cn: 自由在选择被尊重的地方生长。

dict_mnemonic.text: free（自由的）+ -dom（状态）= freedom，字面就是「自由的状态」；同结构的词还有 kingdom（王国）和 wisdom（智慧）。

root: 由古英语 frēo（非奴隶的）加后缀 -dom（状态）构成，核心义「自由的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Freedom means personal liberty, the right to act, or release from something bad.
sensesIntro.cn: freedom 意为人身自由、自主权或免除。

core.en: The condition of living without a chain.
core.cn: 不受锁链束缚的生存状态。

branches.en: The cage opens and the bird leaves.
A student picks a course by choice.
branches.cn: 学生按自己的意愿选课。

branches.en: A burden is lifted from a family.
A free body and a free voice share one state.
branches.cn: 自由的身体与自由的声音同属一种状态。

branches.en: The right to choose and release from harm both widen life.
branches.cn: 选择的权利与免于伤害都拓宽了生活。

intro.cn: freedom 展示了 -dom 如何把词变成状态名词。

definition_en: without limits, without payment, or in large amounts
core_image: 孩子在开阔的草地上张开双臂奔跑
scene: 孩子们在草地上自由地奔跑。The children ran freely on the grass.
sceneCN: 这里 freely 是「自由地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在草地上自由地奔跑。

senses.title: Without limits
senses.definition: in a way that is not held back
senses.definitionCN: 以不受阻碍的方式
senses.example: The children ran freely on the grass.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在草地上自由地奔跑。
senses.why: This is the adverb form of the basic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本义项的副词形式。

senses.title: Without payment
senses.definition: in a way that costs nothing
senses.definitionCN: 以不花钱的方式
senses.example: The samples were given freely to visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 样品免费送给参观者。
senses.why: Free as no cost becomes an adverb.
senses.whyCN: 「免费」的 free 转为副词即此义。

senses.title: In large amounts
senses.definition: in a generous or plentiful way
senses.definitionCN: 以慷慨或充足的方式
senses.example: Tears flowed freely at the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 仪式上泪水纵横。
senses.why: What is not restricted can pour out.
senses.whyCN: 不受限制的东西会大量涌出。

intro.en: Freely is the old adverb built on free.
intro.cn: freely 是由 free 构成的古老副词。

items.cn: 副词后缀 -lice 构成了 freelice。

items.en: It also means at no cost and in plenty.

normal.en: You may speak freely in this room.

normal.en: The river flows freely after the ice melts.
normal.cn: 冰融化后河水自由流淌。

abstract.cn: 自由的脚步不会留下锁链的痕迹。

abstract.en: What is given freely cannot be taken for granted.
abstract.cn: 免费给予的东西不应被视为理所当然。

abstract.en: Freely means the door is already open.

definition_en: to become ice, to stop something, to feel very cold, or a period of frost
core_image: 寒夜里湖面慢慢结出一层白冰
scene: 湖面在一夜寒风中冻住了。The lake froze in the cold night wind.
sceneCN: 这里 freeze 是「结冰」（第 1 个义项）；句意：湖面在一夜寒风中冻住了。

senses.title: To turn into ice
senses.definition: to become hard and solid because of cold
senses.definitionCN: 因寒冷而变硬变实
senses.example: The lake froze in the cold night wind.
senses.exampleCN: 湖面在一夜寒风中冻住了。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of water turning to ice.
senses.whyCN: 这是水变成冰的基本义项。

senses.title: To stop something
senses.definition: to stop money, prices, or activity from moving
senses.definitionCN: 使资金、价格或活动停止变动
senses.example: The company froze all new spending.
senses.exampleCN: 公司冻结了所有新的开支。
senses.why: Something frozen cannot move, so stopping movement borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 冻住的东西不能动，于是「停止」也借用了这个词。

senses.title: To feel very cold
senses.definition: to feel extremely cold
senses.definitionCN: 感到极度寒冷
senses.example: My hands are freezing in this wind.
senses.exampleCN: 这阵风里我的双手冻僵了。
senses.why: The body feels like it is turning to ice.
senses.whyCN: 身体感觉像要结成冰。

senses.title: A period of frost
senses.definition: a time when the weather stays below freezing
senses.definitionCN: 天气持续低于冰点的时期
senses.example: The freeze lasted for two weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 冰冻期持续了两周。
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun for the cold period itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转化为名词，指寒冷期本身。

branches.en: A lake turns solid under the night wind.

definition_en: goods carried by ship, train, or truck, the transport of goods, or the charge for it
core_image: 满载木箱的货运列车驶向港口
scene: 这列火车装满了运往港口的货物。The train was loaded with freight for the port.
sceneCN: 这里 freight 是「货物」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这列火车装满了运往港口的货物。

senses.title: Goods being carried
senses.definition: goods moved by ship, train, truck, or plane
senses.definitionCN: 由船、火车、卡车或飞机运送的货物
senses.example: The train was loaded with freight for the port.
senses.exampleCN: 这列火车装满了运往港口的货物。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of goods in transport.
senses.whyCN: 这是运输中货物的基本义项。

senses.title: The transport of goods
senses.definition: the business or system of moving goods
senses.definitionCN: 运送货物的行业或体系
senses.example: Air freight is faster than shipping by sea.
senses.exampleCN: 空运比海运更快。
senses.why: The cargo gives its name to the whole system.
senses.whyCN: 货物之名也用来指整个运输体系。

senses.title: The charge for transport
senses.definition: the money paid to move goods
senses.definitionCN: 为运送货物支付的费用
senses.example: The freight was higher than the price of the goods.
senses.exampleCN: 运费比货物本身的价格还高。
senses.why: The word for goods also names the cost of moving them.
senses.whyCN: 表示货物的词也用来指运送它们的费用。

intro.cn: freight 从荷兰语中一个与航运有关的词进入英语。

abstract.cn: 货物是一份「箱子终将抵达」的承诺。
